item.title: Whose Simping Male Supporting Character Is Being Held and Kissed by the Male Lead?
item.dc:creator: Hoshi_Moshi
item.description: The comments from the netizens are so real, I really hope that one day Wen Yangyu can be truely happy and free, it’s unluckily to happen anytime soon but it aches my heart seeing him in so much pain and sadness. Especially so since he’s gone through so much pain and hurt unjustly, what breaks my heart the most is that, this kind of pain and trauma lasts forever, while a person and grow from the pain and learn to live life freely again, the scars and the memories will forever be etched into their soul and that’s what hurts the most. I truly hope that one day, whether in this life or the next he can truly live a life free from pain, just happy and content, with his loved ones around him <3
